top_categories.workout_context: 11,926ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
104ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Alpinum Alp-Cerdanya Cycle Tour, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
At mile 60 of 115, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Alpinum Alp-Cerdanya Cycle Tour's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before July.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Alpinum Alp-Cerdanya Cycle Tour. Train it until it feels boring.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 115 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
11,926ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.

Road-specific control matters at Alpinum Alp-Cerdanya Cycle Tour. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 115 miles.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 11,926ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Low-cadence force work supports 11,926ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 115 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.

race_overlay.weather: July in Alp, Girona, Spain. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Alpinum Alp-Cerdanya Cycle Tour. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Alpinum Alp-Cerdanya Cycle Tour’s 115 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Alpinum Alp-Cerdanya Cycle Tour includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, TT Threshold, and Over Under to prepare you for 115 miles of mixed terrain in Alp, Girona, Spain.
